_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. All site copy and content lives here. Components read from this file — you should never need to edit a component to change words. Menu items, prices, and service terms are transcribed verbatim from JTCC's own current menu PDFs (smaller font.pdf, TACO WEB MENU.jpg, PLATED&FAMILY STYLE PRICING.pdf, WEBITE XTRA INFO.png). Nothing here is invented.

seo.title: Joshua Tree Catering Co. | Hand-Crafted Catering in the High Desert
seo.description: Woman-owned boutique catering in Landers, CA. Drop-off catering, taco and enchilada bars, family style and plated service. Serving Joshua Tree and the high desert.
seo.ogDescription: Hand-crafted catering in the high desert. Menus built around your table, not a template.

hero.headline: Food worth sitting down for.
hero.subhead: Hand-crafted catering in the high desert. Woman-owned, cooked to order, never tied to one cuisine.

image.alt: A long table set for dinner in the desert at dusk, candles and glasses down the length of it

intro.heading: We cook by hand.
body: Joshua Tree Catering Co. is a small, woman-owned catering company based in Landers, California.
Tacos one weekend, braised oxtail the next — we've never seen the point of locking ourselves into one cuisine when the better question is what suits your event and the people coming to it.
Most of what we do is private: weddings, birthdays, family gatherings, retreats. Long tables, good plates, nobody rushing off. That's the version of a meal we're after.

menus.heading: Menus
menus.intro: A sampling of the drop-off menu — small serves 5, large serves 10, packaged in aluminum and ready to heat. The full menu runs a good deal longer, and everything on it changes with the season. Ask and we'll send it.

items.name: Breakfast Burritos
items.description: Scrambled eggs, potatoes, cheese, pico de gallo, and house-made salsa.
items.note: Choice of bacon, chorizo, or soyrizo. GF wrap +2.50 per person.

items.name: Lox + Bagels
items.description: Whipped dill cream cheese, Persian cucumber, red onion, caper relish, tomato.
items.note: Choice of plain, sesame, or everything bagels.

items.name: Desert Potatoes
items.description: Roasted potato, garlic, sautéed onion and bell pepper, parmesan over the top.

items.name: Charcuterie
items.description: Artisanal meats and cheeses, dried fruit, nuts and olives, house-made jam, baguette and crackers.

items.name: Mezze
items.description: Roasted garlic baba ghanoush, curried hummus, jalapeño dolmas, pickled turnip, pita and fresh veggies.

items.name: Deviled Eggs
items.description: A dozen eggs, 24 pieces. Classic with mustard aioli and crispy prosciutto, brunch with smoked salmon and fried capers, cacio e pepe, or spinach and artichoke.
items.note: Dozen (24 pieces) or a mixed dozen — pick two.

items.name: ¡Cesar!
items.description: Romaine, cilantro-caesar dressing, pickled red onion, cotija, crispy jalapeños.
items.note: Vegetarian and gluten-free friendly. Add chicken +20 | 40.

items.name: Spring Orzo
items.description: Cherry tomato, cucumber, roasted red peppers, red onion and fennel, rosemary citrus vinaigrette.

items.name: Arugula
items.description: Herbed goat cheese, roasted pistachio, shallot, smoked paprika-honey vinaigrette.

items.name: Birdy and the Beast
items.description: Turkey, roast beef, gouda, pickles, onion, mustard aioli on a french roll.
items.note: Served on platters, cut in half.

items.name: Cubano Wrap
items.description: Smoked ham, bacon, provolone, pickles, sweet-spicy mustard.

items.name: Chickpea Salad Wrap
items.description: Onion and celery, tomato, turmeric, arugula.

items.name: Enchiladas Verde o Roja
items.description: Chicken, mozzarella, Monterey jack and queso fresco, under creamy tomatillo or ancho red sauce.
items.note: Add Mexican rice and charro beans +90 | 180.

items.name: Citrus Grilled Salmon
items.description: Dill and caper, herbed beurre blanc.

items.name: Cottage Pie
items.description: Farmer's market vegetables, lentil, peas and potato, baked under herbed mashed potatoes.

items.name: Canoli
items.description: Sweet cream and tart berry sauce.

menus.footnote: Menu selections are subject to change. Prices hold until a contract is written.

purveyors.heading: Some of our local purveyors
purveyors.intro: We source as much as we can from local, small businesses. Because of that, we ask for two weeks or more for the full menu.

parties.heading: Parties
parties.intro: Weddings, birthdays, retreats, and dinners that run long. Four ways to do it, from a drop-off you host yourself to a plated dinner with a chef in your kitchen.

services.name: Drop-Off Catering
services.description: We cook it, we bring it, you host. Everything arrives in aluminum, ready to heat, with pre-wrapped utensils and napkins.
terms: 20% service charge on all drop-off orders
Delivery starts at $50, based on location and time
Serving utensils, compostable plates, utensils and napkins available on request

services.name: Taco Bar
services.description: Choice of three proteins — chicken tinga, carne asada, carnitas, mama's ground beef, achiote squash, potato and carrot-rizo. Corn tortillas, Mexican rice, chipotle-spiced charro beans, onion, cilantro, lime, and house-made salsas.
terms: Gluten-free, and easily adapted to vegetarian or vegan

services.name: Enchilada Bar
services.description: Hand-rolled chicken enchiladas with mozzarella, pepper jack and queso fresco, under ancho red or creamy tomatillo. Mexican rice, chipotle-spiced charro beans, crema, queso fresco, jalapeño, onion, cilantro.
terms: Make it a party with both bars — 350 | 700

services.name: Family Style
services.description: Every dish on platters down the middle of the table for guests to pass and share. A chef, server, and serving dishware come with it. Two to three weeks out we sit down and build a three-course menu around you.
services.price: From $100 per person, plus food cost

services.name: Plated Service
services.description: A little more formality, for the moments that call for it — anniversaries, proposals, small weddings. Chef and server included, three courses built with you beforehand.
services.price: From $175 per person, plus food cost
terms: 50% deposit reserves the date and time

ordering.heading: All the extra info
notes: Full payment is due when the order is placed. Once payment is processed, menu selections are final.
You can add to an order with at least 3 days' notice.
Delivery times may be adjusted up until noon the day before your event.
We source from local, small businesses — please give us 2+ weeks for full menu availability.
All pricing is subject to change until a contract is provided.

contact.heading: Tell us about your event.
contact.body: Send us the date, roughly how many people, and what you're picturing. We'll come back with a menu draft.
contact.note: Dates go early in spring. Reach out when you know your weekend.
